name: NUB Music Bot
description: 🔥 Ultimate Telegram Voice Chat Music Bot — HD audio/video streaming, multi-language support, premium UI. Powered by Pyrogram (Kurigram) and PyTgCalls.

API_ID.description: Telegram App API ID — get from https://my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Telegram App API Hash — get from https://my.telegram.org

STRING_SESSION.description: Pyrogram v2 user session string for the assistant account

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user ID (get it from @userinfobot)

YOUTUBE_API_KEYS.description: Comma-separated YouTube Data API v3 keys — get from https://console.cloud.google.com (10K req/day free each). Leave blank to use yt-dlp fallback only.

LOGGER_ID.description: Chat ID of a group/channel to receive error logs

NUB_YT_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for external YouTube API proxy (optional)

YT_API_TOKEN.description: Auth token for the external YouTube API proxy (optional)

YT_COOKIES_FILE.description: Path to a Netscape cookies.txt for yt-dlp (age-restricted/region-locked videos). Optional.

COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER.description: Export cookies from a local browser profile at startup: firefox/chrome/chromium/edge/brave/opera/vivaldi/safari/whale. Needs that browser on the host (not available on Heroku container stack). Optional.

COOKIES_BOOTSTRAP_URL.description: URL yt-dlp hits during the cookie export so it exits cleanly and validates the cookies. Optional (has a sensible default).

COOKIES_REFRESH_HOURS.description: Re-export the cookie file every N hours (YouTube rotates tokens mid-session). 0 disables. Optional.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify app Client ID — play Spotify links via YouTube. Create an app at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Leave blank to disable.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Spotify app Client Secret (keep private). Required together with SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID to enable Spotify links.
